title: Watermelon Orangeglo - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Unusual Orange Heirloom
description:
Experience the Sweet, Juicy Delight of Orangeglo Watermelons in Your Garden!


KEY FEATURES
• Produces large, oblong watermelons with vibrant orange flesh.
• Exceptional sweetness and juicy, crisp texture.
• Vigorous plants with good disease resistance.
• Mini plug plants provide a strong head start for successful growth.
• Perfect for summer desserts, snacks, and entertaining.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Citrullus lanatus 'Orangeglo'
Colour: Orange flesh with green striped rind
Season: Summer (July - September in UK with protection)
Growth Habit: Trailing vine
Flavour: Intensely sweet, juicy, and crisp with a distinct tropical undertone
Time to Harvest: Approximately 80-100 days from transplanting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (at least 6-8 hours daily)
Soil: Well-drained, sandy loam, rich in organic matter
Watering: Consistent and deep watering, especially during fruiting. Do not let soil dry out completely.
Spacing: 1.5m - 2.5m (5-8 feet) between plants and rows
Height: Trailing vines up to 2-3m (6-10 feet) in length
Spread: 2-3m (6-10 feet) per plant
Hardiness: UK H1b (requires protection/greenhouse in most UK climates)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Acclimatise plants gradually to outdoor conditions before transplanting after all risk of frost has passed.
• Plant in a warm, sheltered spot or greenhouse for best results in the UK.
• Provide consistent moisture, especially once fruits begin to develop; avoid overhead watering to prevent fungal issues.
• Fertilise regularly with a balanced feed once flowers appear and fruits start to set.
• Support heavy fruits with slings or netting to prevent stem breakage.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
